captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a Nordic wooden stave bell tower. It features a dark-brown timber-framed square shaft with lower paneled walls, cross-braced open belfry railings, and a dark pitched roof. Inside the belfry, a dark cast-iron bell is suspended on a horizontal wooden yoke designed to swing on a revolute joint, while an internal clapper swings independently on a secondary revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a Nordic wooden stave bell tower with a square timber-frame shaft, a pitched roof, and an open belfry. Inside, suspend a cast-iron bell from a horizontal yoke using a revolute joint to allow swinging, and include a secondary revolute joint for an internal clapper.
captions.factory: The code constructs the tower's base and belfry frame using box primitives for the columns, horizontal rails, and cross-braces, positioned via translation and rotation transforms. The pitched roof is created using angled box plates. The bell is constructed using a revolved sketch or combined cylinder/cone primitives, and is connected to a yoke via a revolute joint along the horizontal pitch axis. An internal clapper rod is modeled as a cylinder and sphere, attached to the bell interior using a secondary revolute joint.
